description: This file defines the API for the Slap Module Container Object in the Service Logic Aggregation Plane (SLAP) implementation. It includes function prototypes for creating, removing, enrolling objects, and initializing the module container object, providing interface definitions for external modules.

methods.name: SlapCreateModuleContainer
methods.description: Creates a new module container object given container, owner, and reserved contexts.

methods.name: SlapMcoCreate
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the Slap Module Container.

methods.name: SlapMcoRemove
methods.description: Removes the specified instance of the Slap Module Container.

methods.name: SlapMcoEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls or registers the objects within the module container.
